fields.summary_ko.0: TrendForce turned bearish on NAND flash prices for 2027, sending SNDK down 2% after-hours, with contract pricing forecast to decline 0–5% QoQ from Q1.
fields.summary_ko.1: SNDK surged 2,445% YTD after completing 8:1 stock split, though concerns mount that Chinese cloud providers' sharp cutbacks in enterprise SSD orders will outweigh U.S. demand gains.
